identityTest.versionIdentity: Stage, scope, effective interval or authority changes append successor adoption episodes.

invariants: Every adoption pins one organization and technology.
Stage pins a named scheme and version.
Scope and effective interval are explicit.
Each transition requires authority and decision.
Upstream lifecycle and local stage remain separate.
Vendor support and local stage remain separate.
Product use does not silently create adoption.
No stage value is enumerated in this candidate; stage values resolve only from the pinned stage scheme version, and the record lifecycle and the stage vocabulary are disjoint.
For one organization, technology and scope, at most one episode is effective at any instant, and a successor episode's validFrom equals the predecessor's validTo.
An episode's validFrom is not earlier than the time of its authorizing decision.
A decision reference resolves the rationale, the authorized occurrence and the issued record; a reference that resolves only the issued record is incomplete.
